topic: Using the Coin Counter Machine at the Grocery Store

script.title: AT THE COIN MACHINE
script.story_hook: One heavy jar of coins, one very tired machine.
script.intro_zh: 一整罐沉重的硬幣，和一台累壞的機器。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the coin corner of a grocery store. Listen for money talk and small favors.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到超市門邊的硬幣角。留意關於錢的說法，還有小小的幫忙。
script.outro: That's how a jammed machine turns into a story. Listen once more and count along.
script.outro_zh: 一台卡住的機器就這樣變成一段故事。再聽一次，跟著數一數。
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat each line after the two speakers.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著兩位說話者逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her late fifties with short silver-grey hair, small reading glasses on a beaded chain, a rust orange quilted vest over a cream long sleeve shirt, and a roomy build
script.char_b_description: a laid-back young man in his mid twenties with a low fade of dark brown hair, a navy store polo shirt, a green apron, one silver ear cuff, and a tall lanky build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is the coin machine still working today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi ɪz ðə kɔɪn məˈʃin stɪl ˈwɝkɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，請問硬幣機今天還能用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It mostly works, but it jammed twice this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈmoʊstli wɝks bʌt ɪt dʒæmd twaɪs ðɪs ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 大致沒問題，不過今天早上卡住了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I drove twenty minutes for this jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ aɪ dɹoʊv ˈtwɛnɪ ˈmɪnɪts fɚ ðɪs dʒɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我開了二十分鐘的車，就是為了這一罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a heavy jar, um, what's inside, pennies?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈhɛvi dʒɑɹ ʌm wæts ɪnˈsaɪd ˈpɛniz/
dialogue.zh: 這罐挺重的耶，嗯，裡面是什麼，一分銅板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly quarters, plus a pile of dimes, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ˈkwɔɹtɚs plʌs ə paɪl əv daɪmz aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 大部分是二十五分的，還有一堆十分的，我猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine is by the doors, on your left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin ɪz baɪ ðə dɔɹz ɑn jɔɹ lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 機器就在門口那一邊，你的左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, and does it take bills too or just coins?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɹeɪt ænd dʌz ɪt teɪk ˈbɪlz tu ɔɹ dʒʌst ˈkɔɪns/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那它也可以收紙鈔，還是只收硬幣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just coins now, they took the bill slot out.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈkɔɪns naʊ ðeɪ ˈtʊk ðə ˈbɪl slɑt ˈaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 現在只收硬幣，紙鈔那個入口拆掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Well, is there a fee for cashing out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt wɛl ɪz ðɛɹ ə fi fɚ ˈkæʃɪŋ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 了解。那兌換成現金有手續費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is, it's about ten percent of your total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ɪts əˈbaʊt tɛn pɚˈsɛnt əv jɔɹ ˈtoʊɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 有的，會從總額裡扣掉大約百分之十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten percent? Wow, that hurts a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn pɚˈsɛnt waʊ ðæt hɝts ə ˈlɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 百分之十？哇，這樣扣有點痛耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, but the voucher works like store cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz bʌt ðə ˈvɑʊtʃɚ wɝks laɪk stɔɹ kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 是會扣，但那張代金券花起來就像店裡的現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I can buy groceries with it, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kæn baɪ ˈɡɹɑˌsəz wɪð ɪt ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我可以用它買雜貨，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, groceries, lottery, even the bakery over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈɡɹɑˌsəz ˈlɑtəɹi ˈivən ðə ˈbækəɹi ˈoʊvɚ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，雜貨、彩券，連那邊的麵包店都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Um, can I get real coins back instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ʌm kæn aɪ ɡɛt ɹiəl kɔɪns bæk ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。嗯，那我能不能拿回真的硬幣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not from this one, it only prints vouchers.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fɹʌm ðɪs wʌn ɪt ˈoʊnli prɪnts ˈvɑʊtʃɚz/
dialogue.zh: 這台不行，它只會列印代金券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Okay, I'm pouring these in now.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf oʊˈkeɪ aɪm ˈpɔɹɪŋ ðiz ɪn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 也是。好，我要把硬幣倒進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, I'll watch the screen with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪk jɔɹ ˈtaɪm aɪl ˈwɑtʃ ðə ˈskɹin wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，我陪你一起看螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, it's counting, ninety dollars already, no way.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɪts ˈkaʊɾɪŋ ˈnɪnɪ ˈdɑlɚz ɔlˈɹɛdi noʊ weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，它在數了，已經九十塊，不會吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh wow, that's a serious pile of quarters.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ waʊ ðæts ə ˈsɪɹiəs paɪl əv ˈkwɔɹtɚz/
dialogue.zh: 哇，那真的是一大堆二十五分硬幣耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, it stopped. The screen says machine jammed.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪt stɑpt ðə skɹin sɛz məˈʃin dʒæmd/
dialogue.zh: 等等，它停了。螢幕寫著機器卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh man, third jam today, I'm so sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ mæn θɝd dʒæmd təˈdeɪ aɪm soʊ ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 唉呀，今天第三次卡住，我真的很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, um, do I lose the coins stuck inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ʌm du aɪ lus ðə kɔɪns stʌk ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那，嗯，卡在裡面的硬幣會不見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they're safe in the bin, come back tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðɛɹ seɪf ɪn ðə bɪn kʌm bæk təˈmɑɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不會，它們安全地在收集槽裡，明天再來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow? I really need groceries today, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑɹoʊ aɪ ˈɹɪli nid ˈɡɹɑˌsəz təˈdeɪ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 明天？老實說我今天就要買菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get it, let me ask my manager, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ɪt lɛt mi æsk maɪ ˈmænɪdʒɚ wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，我問一下店長，請等我一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, thank you, I'll wait on that bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ ˈθæŋk ju aɪl ˈweɪt ɑn ðæt ˈbɛntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好，謝謝你，我先在那張長椅坐著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, good news, we can hand count it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɡʊd njuːz wi kæn hænd kaʊnt ɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好消息，我們可以在這裡用手幫你數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That beats the machine, and no fee either?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹiəli ðæt bits ðə məˈʃin ænd noʊ fi ˈiɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那比機器好，而且也不收手續費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fee, it takes ten minutes if you can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fi ɪt teɪks tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɪf ju kæn weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不收，不過要花十分鐘，你可以等的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can wait. Do you need me to help sort?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ˈweɪt du ju nid mi tə ˈhɛlp ˈsɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 我可以等。你需要我幫忙分類嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, you stack, I count, that's a good team.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ ju ˈstæk aɪ ˈkaʊnt ðæts ə ɡʊd ˈtim/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，你堆好，我來數，我們配合得真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is kind of fun, um, like a weird game.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈðɪs ɪz kaɪnd əv ˈfʌn ʌm laɪk ə ˈwɪɹd ˈɡeɪm/
dialogue.zh: 這還有點好玩耶，嗯，像一個怪怪的遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone says that, then nobody wants to do it again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn sɛz ðæt ðɛn ˈnoʊˌbɑdi wɑnts tə du ɪt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 每個人都這樣說，但沒人想再數第二次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, true. Is this about a hundred and thirty?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tru ɪz ðɪs əˈbaʊt ə ˈhʌndɚd ænd ˈθɝɾi/
dialogue.zh: 哈，也是。這大概有一百三十塊了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looks like one thirty five, maybe a little more.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊks laɪk wʌn ˈθɝɾi faɪv ˈmeɪbi ə ˈlɪɾəl mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 看起來是一百三十五，也許再多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, we beat that ten percent cut, small win.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ wi bit ðæt tɛn pɚˈsɛnt kʌt smɑl wɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哇，那百分之十的費用等於省下來了，小贏一把。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your voucher, I signed it for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz jɔɹ ˈvɑʊtʃɚ aɪ saɪnd ɪt fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 這是你的代金券，我幫你簽好名了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use this at the deli counter too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz ðɪs æt ðə ˈdɛli ˈkaʊɾɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 這個也能在熟食櫃台用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works for almost everything, even online.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɝks fɚ ˈoʊlmoʊst ˈɛvɹiˌθɪŋ ˈivən ˌɑnˈlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 基本上店裡什麼都能用，連網路下單也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even online, okay, that's a nice surprise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˌɑnˈlaɪn oʊˈkeɪ ðæts ə naɪs sɚˈpɹaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 連網路也行，好哇，那是個驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The code's at the bottom, just type it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊdz æt ðə ˈbɑtəm dʒʌst taɪp ɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 代碼在最下面那行，只要輸入就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it saved in my notes, perfect, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt sævd ɪn maɪ noʊts ˈpɝfɪkt θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 我存進手機備忘錄了，太好了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, um, call first, that jam repeats weekly.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm ʌm kɔl fɝst ðæt dʒæm ɹɪˈpits ˈwikli/
dialogue.zh: 下次，嗯，記得先打電話，這台每個禮拜都會卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do, and maybe I'll bring a smaller jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du ænd ˈmeɪbi aɪl brɪŋ ə ˈsmɑlɚ dʒɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的，也許我只帶一個小罐子來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, please do, my fingers need a break now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ pliz du maɪ ˈfɪŋɡɚz nid ə bɹeɪk naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，拜託了，我的手指現在需要休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for not letting me drive home empty handed.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔɹ nɑt ˈlɛɾɪŋ mi dɹaɪv hoʊm ˈɛmpi ˈhændɪd/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，沒讓我空手開車回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Oh, we sell coin wrappers by register two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm oʊ wi sɛl kɔɪn ˈɹæpɚz baɪ ˈɹɛdʒəstɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。喔，我們賣硬幣紙套，在二號收銀台旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd rather not buy wrappers, to be honest with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ˈɹæðɚ nɑt baɪ ˈɹæpɚz tə bi ˈɑnəst wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 老實跟你說，我不太想再買紙套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, your bank rolls them free, if you have time.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ jɔɹ ˈbæŋk ˈɹoʊlz ðɛm ˈfri ɪf ju hæv ˈtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 也對，銀行會幫你免費捲好，只要你有時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's my other option, but they close at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ ˈʌðɚ ˈɑpʃən bʌt ðeɪ kloʊz æt fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那是我另一個選擇，但他們四點就關門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and the drive is worse at that hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ænd ðə dɹaɪv ɪz wɝs æt ðæt ˈaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，而且那個時段開車會更塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So today it was really you or the broken machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ təˈdeɪ ɪt wəz ˈɹɪli ju ɔɹ ðə ˈbɹoʊkən məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 所以今天其實就是靠你，或是那台壞掉的機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, yeah, the machine quit, I'm the backup plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jɛ ðə məˈʃin kwɪt aɪm ðə ˈbækˌʌp plæn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，是啊，機器罷工了，我就是備援方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best backup plan I've met all week, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst ˈbækˌʌp plæn aɪv mɛt ɔl wik ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，你是我這週遇過最好的備援。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're sweet. Do you want a bag for your jar?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ˈswit du ju ˈwɑnt ə ˈbæɡ fɚ jɔɹ ˈdʒɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你真好。要不要一個袋子裝你那罐硬幣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, my trunk is full of loose change already.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz maɪ tɹʌŋk ɪz fʊl əv lus tʃeɪndʒ ɔlˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 要的，我的後車廂已經塞滿散硬幣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's a bag, and a coffee, it's on the house.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ə bæɡ ænd ə ˈkɔfi ɪts ɑn ðə haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 給你袋子，還有一杯咖啡，這杯店裡招待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know what, yes, I'll take that, thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ wʌt ˈjɛs aɪl ˈteɪk ðæt ˈθæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 欸，好啊，那我收下，真的謝謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you next coin day, drive safe out there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsi ju ˈnɛkst kɔɪn ˈdeɪ dɹaɪv ˈseɪf aʊt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 下次帶硬幣來囉，路上小心。

script.youtube_title: 【超市硬幣機卡住🪙】「我就是備援方案」教你把一罐硬幣換成現金💵🎧｜聽完敢問手續費｜60句沉浸式英文聽力｜At the Coin Machine
script.youtube_title_en: "I'm the Backup Plan" — Cashing a Jar of Coins at the Grocery Store
script.youtube_description:
超市的硬幣機卡住了，一整罐硬幣該怎麼辦？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英文聽力練習，場景就在超市門邊的硬幣機前，從問機器能不能用、問手續費，一路聽到機器卡住、店員用手幫你數完。

你會聽到：怎麼開口問 Is the coin machine still working today、怎麼問手續費 is there a fee for cashing out；機器當機時怎麼問硬幣會不會丟失、能不能請人人工清點；還有代金券能不能用在熟食櫃台、能不能上網下單的實用問句。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現的是美國人每天在店裡說的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、no way、fair enough。聽完你就會用：Got it、Take your time、I get it、Here's your voucher、Anytime。

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
The coin machine at the grocery store just jammed, and you are holding a giant jar of quarters. What now? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in the little coin corner right by the doors.

You will hear: asking if the machine works, asking about the cash fee, and finding out it takes about ten percent; the jam, the panic about coins stuck inside, and the hand-count rescue with no fee; plus questions about using the paper voucher at the deli counter or online.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, no way, fair enough. By the end you'll own phrases like Got it, Take your time, I get it, Here's your voucher, and Anytime.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen and repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed, just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧超市硬幣機英文｜兌換一罐硬幣・問清手續費・機器卡住人工清點｜代金券能不能全店用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
辛苦存了一整罐硬幣，開二十分鐘的車到超市，硬幣機卻當機了，你會怎麼開口請人幫忙？百分之十的手續費到底要不要付？卡在裡面的硬幣會不會就這樣消失？

這一集帶大家走進超市門邊的硬幣機角落，從問機器能不能用、問手續費、倒硬幣開始數，一路聽到機器卡住、店長同意人工清點、一起數到一百三十五塊，最後拿到代金券與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🪙 開場問句：Excuse me, is the coin machine still working today?
💵 問手續費：Well, is there a fee for cashing out?
🧮 機器當機：Wait, it stopped. The screen says machine jammed.
🎧 人工救援：Okay, good news, we can hand count it here.

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、ha 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這罐硬幣走一趟超市，下次你自己在機器前卡住，話就會自己從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你下次數硬幣，也能遇到一位願意用手幫你數的店員。
